Greystone Managed Investments Upped Enbridge (ENB) Holding; Apple (AAPL) Holder Doheny Asset Management Has Decreased Stake as Market Valuation Declined
May 26, 2018 - By Evgen Dobrzhanskiy
Doheny Asset Management decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.31% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Doheny Asset Management sold 2,990 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 87,224 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.76M, down from 90,214 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Doheny Asset Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Greystone Managed Investments Inc increased its stake in Enbridge Inc (ENB) by 12.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greystone Managed Investments Inc bought 297,617 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.77M shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $108.58M, up from 2.47 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greystone Managed Investments Inc who had been investing in Enbridge Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $53.09B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.08% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $31.24. About 2.96M shares traded. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 26.13% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.68% the S&P500.
Greystone Managed Investments Inc, which manages about $2.41 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Telus Corp (NYSE:TU) by 13,646 shares to 345,979 shares, valued at $13.15M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Fortis Inc (FRTSF) by 23,516 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.83 million shares, and cut its stake in Celgene Corp (NASDAQ:CELG).
